manifest.name: dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus
manifest.description: QQbridge plus — 基于 DeepSeek Harness 与 qq-bridge 的插件：以水鱼（舞萌DX）查分为主（QQ 内 #查分 查 B50、出带曲绘的成绩图，OAuth 授权、不限管理员、不依赖桥接），另附聊天拓展功能（余额与自动关机、推理档位按 DeepSeek 计费峰谷自动切换、节假日表覆盖检查与自动维护、开机/关机提示词、#余额/#关机 管理命令、#功能 开关、#帮助）。判定逻辑直接复用 qq-bridge 的纯模块，不重复实现。

scripts.test: node test/plugin.test.mjs && node test/feature-command.test.mjs && node test/endpoint.test.mjs && node test/maimai-divingfish.test.mjs && node test/maimai-render.test.mjs && node test/maimai-music.test.mjs && node test/maimai-action.test...
scripts.test:maimai: node test/maimai-divingfish.test.mjs && node test/maimai-render.test.mjs && node test/maimai-music.test.mjs && node test/maimai-action.test.mjs

bundle.text:
# dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus - bundle patch layer.
#
# Profile-bundle patches compose over an EMPTY entry list, so every patch here is an
# `insert` appending composition rows. This row registers the `qqbridge` model tool
# (and, when personaSection is on, the qq-bridge operations prompt section).
#
# NOTE: comments are intentionally ASCII-only. Keeping config files free of non-ASCII
# avoids any re-encoding ambiguity between the editing tools and the loader.
#
# config.bridgeDir defaults to the qq-bridge checkout; change it here or in the
# plugin's own config when moving machines.
- insert:
    - id: qqbridge-plus
      name: 'dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus'
      config:
        bridgeDir: 'F:/router/qq-bridge'
        consoleBase: 'http://127.0.0.1:3100'
        personaSection: true
        sectionOrder: 7

readme.section: qqbridge-plus —— 舞萌DX 查分 + 聊天拓展
readme.text:
**基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 与 [qq-bridge](https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge) 的插件：以水鱼（舞萌DX）查分为主，另附一些聊天拓展功能。**

拆开说：

- **水鱼查分** —— 在 QQ 里 `#查分` 查舞萌DX 成绩、出 B50 成绩图（带曲绘）。
  走 OAuth 授权，不限管理员，也**不依赖桥接**：桥接没装好，查分照样能用。
- **聊天拓展** —— 把 qq-bridge 的运维能力接进 AI 的工具面：余额与自动关机、
  推理档位随计费峰谷自动切换、节假日表、开机/关机提示词、`#功能` 开关。

> 本代码由 AI 生成。非常感谢 [Derpyu520](https://github.com/Derpyu520) 开发了
> [qq-bridge](https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge)，没有它这个插件没有任何意义。

readme.section: qqbridge-plus —— 舞萌DX 查分 + 聊天拓展
readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) ｜ 中文

---

装好以后，你可以直接问 AI"机器人余额多少""现在什么状态"，不用再去翻日志；
群里的人也能发 `#查分` 查舞萌DX 成绩、拿到一张带曲绘的 B50 成绩图。
管理员在 QQ 里发一句 `#功能 balance off` 就能关掉某项查询能力，改完立刻生效，
不用编辑文件也不用重启。

具体包括：

| 查询 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 运行状态 | 当前模式、DSH 是否就绪、白名单、管理员、每个会话的未读和唤醒情况 |
| 余额 | 余额多少、数据多久前更新的、告警阈值、真要关机还有多久 |
| 推理档位 | 现在用的是哪一档。分时段功能会在计费高峰切到便宜档、空闲切回好档，省点钱 |
| 节假日表 | 表还够不够用；缺年份的时候可以顺手去国务院通知里抓一份来试算 |
| 开机 / 关机提示词 | 哪些人格配了、会发到哪里 |
| 管理命令 | `#余额` `#关机` `#功能` `#帮助` 的触发词和权限规则 |
| 舞萌DX 查分 | 在 QQ 里 `#查分` 查 B50、出成绩图（带曲绘）；不依赖桥接，也不限管理员 |
| 桥接配置 | 配置内容，令牌已经打码 |

---

计费峰谷、节假日解析、唤醒过滤、余额告警这些判定，插件里一个都没有重写，
全是直接 `import` qq-bridge 自己的纯模块。插件只负责取数、拼文本。

```
qqbridge-plus  ──import──▶  qq-bridge/src/wake-filters.mjs   （计费峰谷 / 节假日 / 唤醒过滤 / 余额决策）
               ──import──▶  qq-bridge/src/whale-balance.js    （余额账本读取）
               ──HTTP────▶  qq-bridge 控制台 127.0.0.1:3100   （运行态：模式、会话、生效档位）
               ◀──HTTP────  qq-bridge 转发来的 QQ 管理命令

这么做是因为 qq-bridge 才是 QQ 侧的权威：SnowLuma 连接、白名单、会话映射、计时器
都在它进程里。判定逻辑再写一份出来，两份迟早会对不上。开发时真撞上过一次：
余额读到 `NaN` 的时候，一边判成 `recovered`、另一边判成 `none`，
而这一步会直接决定要不要关机。功能键的清单同理，桥接那边不另存一份，
否则插件加了功能、桥接反而先把合法命令拒掉。

桥接没在跑的时候插件不会报错，工具会告诉你"控制台不可达"以及怎么排查。

---

| 需要 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Node.js ≥ 18 | DSH 与 qq-bridge 都要求它 |
| git | 用于克隆本仓库（手动安装可以不装，直接下 zip 也行） |
| [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) | 插件宿主。**必须先启动过一次**，否则 profile 目录还不存在 |
| [qq-bridge](https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge) | 本插件直接 `import` 它的纯模块并调它的端点，**必须先装好** |

> qq-bridge 的位置不用提前告诉安装器：它默认去插件目录的隔壁找 `qq-bridge`，
> 找不到时用 `--bridge-dir` 指定。

readme.section: 方式 A：自动安装（推荐）
readme.text:
**先干跑看一眼它要改什么**（第一次建议这么做）：

```bat
node "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus\scripts\install.mjs" ^
     --dir "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus" --dry-run
```

确认没问题就去掉 `--dry-run`。完整流程（克隆 + 安装）：

**Windows（cmd 或 PowerShell）**

```bat
git clone https://github.com/xueyingneko/qqbridge-plus.git "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus"
node "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus\scripts\install.mjs" --dir "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus"
```

**Linux / macOS / Git Bash**

readme.section: 方式 A：自动安装（推荐）
readme.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/xueyingneko/qqbridge-plus.git ~/dsh-plugins/qqbridge-plus
node ~/dsh-plugins/qqbridge-plus/scripts/install.mjs --dir ~/dsh-plugins/qqbridge-plus
```

**qq-bridge 不在隔壁**时：

```bat
node "...\scripts\install.mjs" --dir "...\qqbridge-plus" --bridge-dir "D:\path\to\qq-bridge"
```

**要装进 web profile 而不是 desktop**：加 `--profile web`。

**已经在仓库目录里**，也可以直接用包装脚本（它会自动认出当前目录）：

```bat
scripts\install.cmd --dry-run
```

安装器做的事，每一步都幂等，重复跑不会重复写入：

readme.section: 方式 A：自动安装（推荐）
readme.text:
1. 克隆仓库，或对已有仓库执行 `git pull`；
2. 在插件目录装唯一的 npm 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`；
3. 把包注册进 profile 的 `package.json`：`dependencies` 加 `link:` 项，`dsh.profile.bundles` 加包名；
4. 往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 追加插件 entry（已经存在就跳过）；
5. 让包管理器在 profile 里建好 `node_modules` 链接（优先 pnpm，以匹配 profile 自己的 lockfile）；
6. 检查 qq-bridge 是否就位，并打印后续步骤。

改 profile 文件之前会先备份成 `package.json.bak-<时间戳>`，写入用临时文件加 rename，
避免写一半被别的进程读到。

readme.section: 方式 A：自动安装（推荐）
readme.text:
**卸载**：从 profile 的 `package.json` 里删掉 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中的
`dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus`，再删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里带
`# === dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus (managed by install.mjs) ===` 标记的那条 entry，重启 DSH。

```yaml
- id: qqbridge-plus
  name: dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus
  config:
    bridgeDir: '/abs/path/to/qq-bridge'   # ← 改成你的 qq-bridge 路径

`id` 必须写 `qqbridge-plus`（DSH 用 entry id 定位设置的命名空间），`name` 必须写包名。

第二步不能省。包内自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 只描述"这个 bundle 有哪些行"，
真正让 loader 建出 entry 的是 profile 层的 patch。只做第一步的话，
插件管理器会报 `installed=true`、行配置也齐全，但工具根本不存在，而且没有任何报错。

**第三步，重启 DSH。**

重启 DSH 之后，任选一种确认：

- 问 AI"机器人状态"，它应该能调到 `qqbridge` 工具；
- 或看桥接目录下的 `state/plugin-apply.json`，里面有本次装配的 `trace`：

```json
  { "trace": [ { "phase": "apply-called" }, { "phase": "tool-registered" },
               { "phase": "http-api-registered" }, { "phase": "apply-returned" } ] }
  ```

只到 `apply-called` 就没了，说明装配中途失败；完全没有这个文件，说明插件没被加载。

readme.section: 4. 让 QQ 侧也能改开关（可选）
readme.text:
在 qq-bridge 的 `config.json` 里加：

```json
"featureCommand": {
  "triggers": ["#功能", "#开关"],
  "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:19387"
},

`baseUrl` 指向 DSH web，插件端点挂在它上面。改完重启 qq-bridge。

---

```
#帮助                     列出全部管理命令（触发词按当前配置渲染）
#功能                     查看全部开关（标 * 的是在 QQ 里改过的）
#功能 balance off         关闭某个功能（也接受 关 / 禁用 / off / 0）
#功能 balance 开          开启（也接受 启用 / on / 1）

- 触发词可配（`featureCommand.triggers` / `helpCommand.triggers`）。
- 帮助文本里的触发词是从配置读出来拼的，所以改过触发词之后它也会跟着变，
  不会给你一份对不上号的说明。
- 只有管理员（qq-bridge 的 `ownerQQ`）能用；没配 `ownerQQ` 时这些命令对谁都不可用。

```
#查分                          这台机器上查分能不能用
#查分 柚子                     直接写用户名 = 查公开 B50
#查分 b50 柚子                 同上，显式写子操作
#查分 b50                      查我自己（需先完成绑定）

- **不限管理员**——谁都能查自己的成绩。但"查自己的"必须先完成一次绑定，
  而绑定要求**你本人**在水鱼页面上点「同意授权」。
- 触发词可配（`maimaiCommand.triggers`，默认 `#查分` / `#maimai`）。
- 句首的全角空格、零宽字符会被自动清掉——它们肉眼看不出，却足以让 `#查分` 匹配失败。
- `bind` / `confirm` 的链接与确认码**只走私聊**，群里最多留一句"已私发"。
  这不是多余的谨慎：链接谁都能转发，确认码只出现在点同意那个人的浏览器里。

---

一个工具 `qqbridge`，10 个 action：

| action | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | 总览：模式 / 就绪 / 管理员 / 白名单 / 余额 / 档位 / 各会话 |
| `balance` | 余额、观测新鲜度、阈值、自动关机倒计时 |
| `schedule` | 计费峰谷与档位；`testAt=[时间戳…]` 可试算任意时刻 |
| `holidays` | 节假日表覆盖；`fetch=true` 现场抓取解析试算（不落盘） |
| `greeting` | 开机 / 关机提示词配置、目标、各人格卡覆盖 |
| `commands` | `#余额` `#关机` 触发词与权限口径 |
| `config` | 桥接配置摘要（令牌已脱敏）；`key="role.balanceAlarm"` 取子段 |
| `features` | 功能开关：查看，或用 `set`/`enabled` 修改，或 `reset` |
| `maimai` | 舞萌DX 查分（见下一节） |
| `firstRun` | 重看首次运行引导 |

接入[水鱼查分器](https://diving-fish.com)。这部分**与 qq-bridge 无关**——桥接没装好也能用。

```
qqbridge  action=maimai, sub=status                    这台机器上查分能不能用
qqbridge  action=maimai, sub=b50, username=某人        公开查询（对方需自行公开成绩）
qqbridge  action=maimai, sub=b50, qq=<QQ号>            查自己的（需先完成 OAuth 绑定）
qqbridge  action=maimai, sub=song, songId=11823        查某首歌的定数

`sub=b50` 默认会**出一张成绩图**（1080 宽 PNG），写在系统临时目录下并把路径交给你；
不想要图就加 `image=false`。

readme.section: 为什么不支持"按 QQ 号随便查"
readme.text:
水鱼已经弃用开发者 token（`DIVINGFISH_TOKEN`）。原因是它**能按 QQ 号读取任意用户的成绩**，
而那些用户从未对机器人授权、也无法撤销——用它做出来的"查分"，本质是一个无需同意就能
窥探他人成绩的工具。所以本插件**只实现 OAuth**：

| 环节 | 做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 机器人持有的凭据 | 只有你自己申请的应用 `clientId` / `clientSecret` |
| QQ 号 | 只以 `sha256("<clientId>:<QQ号>")` 摘要外发，**号码本身不离开机器人** |
| 用户令牌 | 只在**内存**缓存（5 分钟，提前 30 秒失效），**不落盘** |
| 绑定 | 用户发 `bind` 拿到链接 → 本人点「同意授权」→ 把页面给的**一次性确认码**发回来 |
| 撤销 | 用户随时可在 https://auth.diving-fish.com/apps 撤销 |
| 未绑定用户 | 仍可用公开查询（按用户名） |

readme.section: 为什么不支持"按 QQ 号随便查"
readme.text:
那个确认码不是多余的手续：绑定链接谁都能转发，而确认码只出现在**点同意那个人的浏览器**里。
少了它，别人可以拿你的 `clientId` 造一条链接发给受害者、骗对方授权从而绑上别人的账号。

```yaml
maimai:
  clientId: '你的应用 ID'          # https://auth.diving-fish.com/apps 申请
  clientSecret: '你的应用密钥'
  proxy: false                     # 境外服务器可开

申请应用时，**接入方式选「bot / 工具」**（设备码绑定 + 换票，无需回调地址）——这正是本插件的流程。
部署形态选「由你自己部署运行」（机密客户端，用 `client_secret`）；

**需要勾的权限只有三项**（全部只读）：

| 权限 | 为什么需要 |
| --- | --- |
| `profile` | 账号基本信息 |
| `prober.profile.read` | Rating、姓名框等汇总资料 |
| `prober.records.read` | **B50 的逐条成绩记录**（少这项查询会 403） |

**不要勾任何 `write` 权限**——本插件没有任何写入路径。而且水鱼会因此把申请转人工审核，
只会拖慢自己。`chunithm.*`（中二节奏）也与本插件无关。

留空时插件不会静默失败，而是明确告诉你去申请（`sub=status` 会报告当前状态）。

**安装器会自动装上**（第 2 步），装完还会**实测渲染一张 PNG** 才报成功——不只看"命令返回 0"。
之所以要实测：它是原生模块（N-API 预编译），在少数平台/架构上可能装到却加载失败，
只报"install 成功"会让人以为出图可用，直到真去查分时才发现。

手动装也一样：

```bash
cd <插件目录> && npm install
```

万一它没装上（或平台不支持），**插件其余部分照常可用**——查分、搜曲、开关都不受影响，
只是不出图，`sub=status` 会明确告诉你去装什么。这是刻意的：**画图是附加价值，
不该让主功能一起挂掉**。

> 依赖只有这一个。`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（Config 校验用）**刻意不列为依赖**：
> 它由 DSH 宿主提供，插件代码会用多路径回退去宿主 profile 里找，找不到还能降级成
> `Config = undefined`（跳过校验），本机实测两条路都能跑。把它列成依赖会连带拉进
> cosmokit 等一整套，安装从数十秒变成数分钟，而且**万一它被装进某个与宿主共享的目录，
> 还可能干扰宿主依赖树**（这个坑真踩过）。

搜索用子序列匹配，所以简写也能命中：`ztn` → `Zitronectar`。排序按匹配质量
（完全相等 > 前缀 > 包含 > 艺人 > 子序列），查询短于 3 个字符时不走子序列兜底，避免误报。

成绩图的歌曲封面是 **SEGA 的游戏素材**，本仓库是 MIT，**不能把它打包进来**。所以这里的
做法是：**素材由你自己准备，插件只负责读**。没配就没有封面，卡片退回"曲名推导出的稳定色条"
（同一首歌颜色恒定），功能不受影响。

配好之后效果：一屏 50 张卡的封面。实测对真实 B50 命中 **49/50**。

用一个命令从公开的国服曲数据库同步到本机：

```
#查分 sync            下载到 maimai.jacketDir 指定的目录
```

```
=== 曲绘同步 ===
目录：E:/qqbridge-plus/jackets
曲数据库共 1293 首，本地已有 0 张
本轮下载 52 张（3.1 MB）

> **那个曲数据库没有声明许可**（未声明即保留所有权利）。所以我既没有把它打包进本仓库，
> 也没有替你分发——**下载动作由你自己的机器发起、文件落在你自己的磁盘上**，本插件只是读取方。
> 需要商用或再分发时，请自行确认素材授权。
> 来源：<https://github.com/CrazyKidCN/maimaiDX-CN-songs-database>

**要有耐心**：GitHub 未认证接口**每小时只有 60 次请求**，而曲数据库有 1293 首。一次下不完，
所以同步是**增量可续**的——反复执行即可，已下载的不会重下。想让它自己慢慢下完，可以挂
常驻进程（它会自己按额度重置时间等待，而不是空转）：

```bash
node scripts/sync-jackets.mjs --dir E:/qqbridge-plus/jackets
```

> 两个实测过的坑，都写进代码注释了：① `raw.githubusercontent.com` 在部分网络下恒返回
> 502，所以走 `api.github.com`；② Node 直连 GitHub 可能报 `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE`
> （系统证书库里有一层 Node 自带 CA 集不认的链），插件会在同步时**自动合并系统 CA**，
> 无需加命令行参数。

文件名含**曲目 id** 最可靠（`11576.png`）；也认 `by-title/<曲名>.png`（同步器用的就是这种）。
匹配**不区分大小写**——曲数据库里同时存在 `Trust` 与 `TRUST`，在 Windows 上它们是同一个
文件、在 Linux 上是两个。

---

每个功能一个布尔开关，`false` 表示关闭，支持 `'*'` 兜底，默认全开。

生效优先级：

```
QQ / 运行时覆盖文件  >  组合行配置  >  代码默认（全开）
```

也就是"在 QQ 里改过的"压过"配置里写的"。覆盖写在 `qq-bridge/state/plugin-features.json`，
用临时文件加 rename 的方式原子写入，避免另一个进程读到半个 JSON；DSH 重启后仍然保留，
`#功能 reset` 可以清空。状态文件损坏时按"没有覆盖"处理并记录原因，不会让插件起不来。

八个键，默认全开：

| 键 | 对应能力 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | 总览 |
| `balance` | 余额与自动关机 |
| `schedule` | 计费峰谷与推理档位 |
| `holidays` | 节假日表 |
| `greeting` | 开机/关机提示词 |
| `commands` | 管理命令现状 |
| `config` | 桥接配置摘要 |
| `maimai` | 舞萌DX 查分 |

- action 仍然留在枚举里，调用时返回一句明确的话，而不是把 action 删掉让人猜：

```
  ⛔ 功能「余额与自动关机」已在插件配置里关闭。
  当前开启的功能：status（总览）、schedule（计费峰谷与推理档位）…
  ```

不从枚举里删掉的原因：工具 schema 在 `defineTool()` 时就序列化好了，之后无法随配置增删。
  与其造成"配置改了但枚举没变"的假象，不如让关闭状态看得出来。

- `status` 里对应的段落会写明原因：`⛔ 已关闭（features.balance=false）`。
- 系统提示词按开关生成，已关闭的功能不会出现在里面，免得模型白白尝试。
- 开关名拼错会告警，并写进 `plugin-apply.json` 的 trace。这类开关最容易出的问题就是
  把 `schedule` 写成 `scheduler`，看起来"设了却没生效"。

---
都是开发时踩出来的，改代码前建议先读一遍。

readme.section: 1. `inject` 里要列出所有会被访问的服务
readme.text:
Cordis 规定访问未在 `inject` 中声明的服务属性会直接抛错：

```
Error: cannot get property "systemPrompt" without inject
```

最初只声明了 `tools`，想用 `if (ctx.systemPrompt)` 做可选依赖兜底，
结果读取属性这一步就抛错了，兜底代码根本执行不到。而这类错误在插件管理器里
只表现为 `[failed]` 或 "did not activate"，不显示原因。

readme.section: 2. 不要导出 `Config`，除非它是真正的 schemastery schema
readme.text:
loader 看到 `Config` 导出会拿它做校验，并且期望它来自 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`。
给一个普通对象会在 apply 之前就失败（现象是 entry 建出来了、apply 一行没跑）。
而 schemastery 是裸包名依赖，插件目录如果没自己的 `node_modules` 就解析不到，
整个模块会在导入期加载失败。

还有一条实测出来的边界：`volatile` 字段会让 loader 把配置求值成 `{}`。
DSH 设置页要可写就要求字段带 `volatile`，但实测（原始证据留在 `lib/last-apply-config.json`）
loader 求值后所有带 volatile 的字段都变成了 `{}`，于是 `sectionOrder` 不再是数字，
`order must be a finite number` 直接让插件不出现；就算绕过这一点，
在设置页点"保存"也会把配置写坏。所以本插件的设置面板做成只读，
改开关交给 QQ 命令和配置文件。测试里有一条断言守着这件事。

readme.section: 3. `defineTool` 要用模块顶层的静态导入
readme.text:
`lib/index.js` 里用的是写死绝对路径的静态导入，和官方插件同一种做法。
最初为了"稳妥"改成运行时动态 `import()` 加 7 条回退路径，结果出现了最难查的一种失败：
某条路径报了 import 成功，但链上的 `.then` 永远不执行——不报错也不进 catch——
工具就这么一直没注册上。

纯 node 子进程读不到 `app.asar` 内部，所以这个模块没法在普通 node 里导入。
这是 Electron 的 asar 特性，不是缺陷；测试请用 `test/` 下不导入该文件的用例。

**排查用的自检**：装配过程会写 `qq-bridge/state/plugin-apply.json`，里面的 `trace` 数组
记录了走到哪一步。宿主 console 在 GUI 里看不到，loader 启动失败又不给原因，
这个文件是唯一不用猜的判据。

---

插件和 qq-bridge 属于跨仓库依赖。qq-bridge 启动时会报出两边的版本：

```
[bridge] 版本：qq-bridge 0.2.0
[bridge]       插件：dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus 1.1.1
```

两边都只以各自 `package.json` 的 `version` 为准，不另外维护一份。
这条也是踩出来的：曾在一个模块里硬写了版本常量，和 `package.json` 对不上，
等于没有可信的版本号。

---

```bash
npm test                                             # 插件侧全部 7 套：190 项
npm run test:maimai                                   # 只跑舞萌查分的 4 套：99 项
node ../qq-bridge/scripts/test-feature-command.mjs   # 桥接侧纯函数：28 项
node ../qq-bridge/scripts/e2e-feature-command.mjs    # 端到端：10 项（需两端都在运行）

CI 只跑不依赖 qq-bridge 的那几套，需要桥接在跑的两套留在本地跑——
写一个必然失败的 CI 不如没有 CI。

舞萌查分的测试用**依赖注入**拦住了网络，所以不需要任何凭据就能跑；
成绩图那套还会在"没装画图库"时自动改测降级路径（7 项），装了就测完整路径（21 项）。

几条关键的安全与正确性断言：

| 断言 | 为什么重要 |
| --- | --- |
| `config` 摘要不得含未脱敏的 `accessToken` | 模型上下文会长期保存 |
| 拼错的开关键不得关掉任何功能 | "设了没生效"最难查 |
| 任何字段都不得带 `volatile` | 会让 loader 把配置求值成 `{}`，保存即损坏 |
| 端点无令牌时必须拒绝或不注册 | 它能放宽整个工具面 |
| `#功能xyz` 不得被当成命令 | 误判会吞掉普通发言，表现为"机器人忽然不理人" |
| 源码里不得出现 `developer-token` | 它能按 QQ 号读任意人成绩，用户无法撤销 |
| 绑定请求必须带 `handoff=code`，且请求体不含明文 QQ 号 | 少了确认码就能被转发链接骗授权 |
| 展示打码、`client_secret` 不得出现在任何输出里 | 输出会进模型上下文与 QQ 聊天记录 |
| 出图路由必须挡掉 `../` 与非 `.png` | 否则变成任意文件读取 |
| 出图失败不得让查分本身失败 | 图是附加价值 |

---
[MIT](LICENSE)。第三方组件与合规边界（含 SnowLuma 许可说明、数据出机清单）见 LICENSE 后半部分。

readme.section: qqbridge-plus — MaimaiDX score lookup + chat extensions
readme.text:
**A plugin built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) and [qq-bridge](https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge): primarily Diving-Fish (MaimaiDX) score lookup, plus a set of chat extensions.**

Broken down:

readme.section: qqbridge-plus — MaimaiDX score lookup + chat extensions
readme.text:
- **Diving-Fish score lookup** — `#查分` in QQ for a MaimaiDX score, rendered as a B50 image with
  song artwork. It uses OAuth, is open to everyone rather than admins only, and **does not depend on
  the bridge**: it works even if qq-bridge is not installed.
- **Chat extensions** — qq-bridge's operational abilities wired into the AI's tool surface: balance
  and auto-shutdown, reasoning tier switching with billing peaks, the holiday table, startup /
  shutdown greetings, and the `#功能` toggles.

readme.section: qqbridge-plus — MaimaiDX score lookup + chat extensions
readme.text:
> This code was generated by AI. Many thanks to
> [Derpyu520](https://github.com/Derpyu520) for building
> [qq-bridge](https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge) — without it this plugin would have no
> reason to exist.

English ｜ [中文](README.md)

---

Once installed you can just ask the AI "what's the bot's balance?" or "what state is it in?",
instead of digging through logs. Anyone in the group can also send `#查分` to look up a
MaimaiDX score and get a B50 card with song artwork. And the admin can send `#功能 balance off`
in QQ to turn a query off — it takes effect immediately, no file editing, no restart.

Here is what you can look up:

| Query | What comes back |
| --- | --- |
| Runtime | current mode, whether DSH is ready, the allowlist, the owner, unread count and wake state per conversation |
| Balance | how much is left, how fresh that number is, the alert threshold, and how long until it actually shuts down |
| Reasoning tier | which tier is active right now. The schedule switches to the cheaper tier during DeepSeek's billing peak and back to the good one off-peak, which saves a bit of money |
| Holiday table | whether the table still covers you; when a year is missing you can pull the State Council notice and see what it would parse to |
| Greetings | which personas have a startup/shutdown line configured, and where those go |
| Admin commands | triggers and permission rules for `#余额` `#关机` `#功能` `#帮助` |
| MaimaiDX scores | `#查分` in QQ for a B50, rendered as an image with song artwork; independent of qq-bridge, and open to everyone |
| Bridge config | the config itself, with tokens masked |

None of the decision logic is re-implemented here. Billing peak/off-peak, holiday parsing, wake
filtering and balance alerts are all `import`ed straight from qq-bridge's own pure modules. The
plugin only fetches data and formats text.

```
qqbridge-plus  ──import──▶  qq-bridge/src/wake-filters.mjs   (billing / holidays / wake / balance)
               ──import──▶  qq-bridge/src/whale-balance.js    (balance ledger)
               ──HTTP────▶  qq-bridge console 127.0.0.1:3100  (runtime: mode, sessions, tier)
               ◀──HTTP────  QQ admin commands forwarded by qq-bridge

The reason is that qq-bridge is the authority on the QQ side: the SnowLuma connection, the
allowlists, session mapping and timers all live in its process. A second copy of the decision logic
would drift from the first sooner or later, and during development it actually did. With a `NaN`
balance, one side judged `recovered` while the other judged `none` — and that is the branch that
decides whether to shut the bot down. The feature-key list works the same way: the bridge does not
keep its own copy, otherwise the plugin adds a feature and the bridge starts rejecting a perfectly
valid command first.

When the bridge is not running the plugin does not throw. The tool tells you the console is
unreachable and how to go about checking it.

---

| Needed | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Node.js ≥ 18 | required by both DSH and qq-bridge |
| git | to clone this repo (skippable for a manual install from a zip) |
| [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) | the plugin host. Must have been **started at least once**, otherwise the profile directory does not exist yet |
| [qq-bridge](https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge) | the plugin `import`s its pure modules and calls its endpoints, so it must be installed first |

> You do not need to tell the installer where qq-bridge is: by default it looks for a `qq-bridge`
> directory next to the plugin. If that is not where yours lives, pass `--bridge-dir`.

**Dry-run first** to see exactly what it would change (worth doing the first time):

```bat
node "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus\scripts\install.mjs" ^
     --dir "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus" --dry-run
```

Drop `--dry-run` once it looks right. Full flow (clone plus install):

**Windows (cmd or PowerShell)**

```bat
git clone https://github.com/xueyingneko/qqbridge-plus.git "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus"
node "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus\scripts\install.mjs" --dir "%USERPROFILE%\dsh-plugins\qqbridge-plus"
```

**Linux / macOS / Git Bash**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xueyingneko/qqbridge-plus.git ~/dsh-plugins/qqbridge-plus
node ~/dsh-plugins/qqbridge-plus/scripts/install.mjs --dir ~/dsh-plugins/qqbridge-plus
```

**If qq-bridge is not next to the plugin**:

```bat
node "...\scripts\install.mjs" --dir "...\qqbridge-plus" --bridge-dir "D:\path\to\qq-bridge"
```

**To install into the web profile instead of desktop**: add `--profile web`.

**Already inside the repo?** The wrapper script figures that out on its own:

```bat
scripts\install.cmd --dry-run
```

What the installer does — every step is idempotent, so re-running writes nothing twice:

Profile files are backed up before being modified, as `package.json.bak-<timestamp>`, and writes
go through a temp file plus rename so another process can never read a half-written file.

**Uninstall**: remove `dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus` from `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` in the
profile's `package.json`, delete the entry carrying the
`# === dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus (managed by install.mjs) ===` marker from `cordis.patch.yml`, and
restart DSH.

**Step two, add an entry to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`**:

```yaml
- id: qqbridge-plus
  name: dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus
  config:
    bridgeDir: '/abs/path/to/qq-bridge'   # ← point at your qq-bridge checkout

The `id` must be `qqbridge-plus` (DSH uses the entry id to locate the settings namespace) and the
`name` must be the package name.

Step two is not optional. A bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml` only describes which rows that bundle
carries; the profile-level patch is what makes the loader create the entry. With step one only,
the plugin manager reports `installed=true` and lists the row, yet the tool does not exist at all
— and no error is printed.

**Step three, restart DSH.**

After restarting DSH, either of these will tell you:

- ask the AI for the bot's status — it should reach the `qqbridge` tool;
- or look at `state/plugin-apply.json` in the bridge directory, whose `trace` records this assembly:

```json
  { "trace": [ { "phase": "apply-called" }, { "phase": "tool-registered" },
               { "phase": "http-api-registered" }, { "phase": "apply-returned" } ] }
  ```

A trace that stops at `apply-called` means assembly failed partway; no file at all means the
  plugin was never loaded.

In qq-bridge's `config.json`:

```json
"featureCommand": {
  "triggers": ["#功能", "#开关"],
  "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:19387"
},

`baseUrl` points at the DSH web server, where the plugin endpoint is mounted. Then restart
qq-bridge.

---

```
#帮助                     list all admin commands (triggers rendered from current config)
#功能                     show all toggles (values changed from QQ are marked *)
#功能 balance off         disable a feature (also 关 / 禁用 / off / 0)
#功能 balance 开          enable (also 启用 / on / 1)

- Triggers are configurable (`featureCommand.triggers` / `helpCommand.triggers`).
- The help text is assembled from the configured triggers, so it follows any change you make and
  can never contradict your setup.
- Admin only (qq-bridge's `ownerQQ`). With no `ownerQQ` configured these commands are unusable
  for everyone.

```
#查分                          is score lookup usable on this machine
#查分 柚子                     just a username = public B50 lookup
#查分 b50 柚子                 same, with the sub-command written out
#查分 b50                      my own B50 (requires a completed binding first)

- **Not admin-only** — anyone can look up their own scores. "My own" requires a one-time binding,
  and binding requires **you personally** to click "authorize" on the Diving-Fish page.
- Triggers are configurable (`maimaiCommand.triggers`, defaults `#查分` / `#maimai`).
- A leading ideographic space or zero-width character is stripped first — invisible, yet enough to
  make `#查分` fail to match.
- The link and confirmation code from `bind` / `confirm` go **only by DM**; the group at most sees
  "sent to your DM". That is not needless caution: a link can be forwarded by anyone, while the
  confirmation code only ever appears in the browser of whoever clicked authorize.

| action | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | Overview: mode / readiness / owner / allowlist / balance / tier / sessions |
| `balance` | Balance, observation freshness, thresholds, auto-shutdown countdown |
| `schedule` | Billing peak/off-peak and tier; `testAt=[ts…]` evaluates any moment |
| `holidays` | Holiday table coverage; `fetch=true` performs a live dry-run parse |
| `greeting` | Startup / shutdown greeting config, targets, per-persona coverage |
| `commands` | `#余额` `#关机` triggers and permission rules |
| `config` | Bridge config summary (tokens redacted); `key="role.balanceAlarm"` for a subtree |
| `features` | Feature toggles: view, or modify with `set`/`enabled`, or `reset` |
| `maimai` | MaimaiDX score lookup (see the next section) |
| `firstRun` | Re-read the first-run guidance |

Talks to the [Diving-Fish prober](https://diving-fish.com). This part is **unrelated to qq-bridge** —
it works even if the bridge is not installed.

```
qqbridge  action=maimai, sub=status                    is lookup usable on this machine
qqbridge  action=maimai, sub=b50, username=someone     public lookup (they must have made scores public)
qqbridge  action=maimai, sub=b50, qq=<QQ number>       my own (requires a completed OAuth binding)
qqbridge  action=maimai, sub=song, songId=11823        the constants for one song

`sub=b50` renders a **score image** (1080 px wide PNG) by default, writes it to the system temp
directory and hands you the path; add `image=false` if you do not want the image.

readme.section: Why there is no "look up any QQ number"
readme.text:
Diving-Fish has retired the developer token (`DIVINGFISH_TOKEN`). The reason: it could **read any
user's scores by QQ number**, and those users never authorized the bot and cannot revoke it — a
"score lookup" built on it is really a tool for prying into other people's records without consent.
So this plugin implements **OAuth only**:

readme.section: Why there is no "look up any QQ number"
readme.text:
| Step | How it works |
| --- | --- |
| Credentials the bot holds | Only your own application's `clientId` / `clientSecret` |
| QQ number | Sent out only as `sha256("<clientId>:<QQ number>")`; **the number itself never leaves the bot** |
| User token | Cached **in memory only** (5 minutes, invalidated 30 s early), **never written to disk** |
| Binding | User runs `bind` to get a link → clicks "authorize" personally → sends back the **one-time confirmation code** shown on that page |
| Revoking | Users can revoke any time at https://auth.diving-fish.com/apps |
| Unbound users | Can still use public lookup (by username) |

readme.section: Why there is no "look up any QQ number"
readme.text:
The confirmation code is not red tape: a binding link can be forwarded by anyone, while the code
only ever appears in the browser of whoever clicked authorize. Without it, someone could craft a
link with your `clientId`, send it to a victim, and bind that victim's account to themselves.

```yaml
maimai:
  clientId: 'your application ID'      # apply at https://auth.diving-fish.com/apps
  clientSecret: 'your application secret'
  proxy: false                         # enable on servers outside mainland China

When applying, pick **"bot / tool"** as the integration type (device-code binding plus token
exchange, no callback URL needed) — that is exactly this plugin's flow.
Choose "run it yourself" as the deployment type (confidential client, uses `client_secret`).

**Only three scopes need ticking** (all read-only):

| Scope | Why it is needed |
| --- | --- |
| `profile` | basic account information |
| `prober.profile.read` | Rating, name plate and similar summary data |
| `prober.records.read` | **the per-chart records behind B50** (without it queries return 403) |

**Do not tick any `write` scope** — this plugin has no write path at all. It would also push your
application into manual review, which only slows you down. `chunithm.*` (Chunithm) is irrelevant here.

When left empty the plugin does not fail silently; it tells you to go apply (`sub=status` reports
the current state).

**The installer installs it for you** (step 2), and then **actually renders a PNG** before
reporting success — it does not just check "the command returned 0". The reason: it is a native
module (N-API prebuilt) that can install yet fail to load on some platforms/architectures, and
reporting only "install succeeded" would make you believe images work until you actually look up
a score.

Search uses subsequence matching, so abbreviations work too: `ztn` finds `Zitronectar`. Results are
ranked by match quality (exact > prefix > substring > artist > subsequence), and queries shorter
than 3 characters skip the subsequence fallback to avoid false hits.

The song artwork on score cards is **SEGA game material**, and this repository is MIT, so it
**cannot be bundled here**. The approach is therefore: **you supply the assets, the plugin only
reads them.** Without them there is no artwork and cards fall back to a stable colour strip
derived from the song title (the same song always gets the same colour); nothing else changes.

With assets in place you get jacket art on all 50 cards. Measured against a real B50: **49/50 hits**.

One command syncs them from a public CN song database:

```
#查分 sync            downloads into the directory set in maimai.jacketDir
```

```
=== 曲绘同步 ===
目录：E:/qqbridge-plus/jackets
曲数据库共 1293 首，本地已有 0 张
本轮下载 52 张（3.1 MB）

> **That song database declares no license** (no license means all rights reserved). So it is
> neither bundled in this repository nor redistributed by the plugin — **your own machine performs
> the download and the files land on your own disk**; the plugin is only a reader. Check the asset
> licensing yourself if you intend to use or redistribute it commercially.
> Source: <https://github.com/CrazyKidCN/maimaiDX-CN-songs-database>

**Be patient**: GitHub's unauthenticated API allows only **60 requests per hour**, and the database
has 1293 songs, so one run cannot finish. Sync is therefore **incremental and resumable** — just run
it again; what is already downloaded is not re-fetched. To let it finish on its own, run the
persistent process (it waits for the quota to reset instead of busy-looping):

```bash
node scripts/sync-jackets.mjs --dir E:/qqbridge-plus/jackets
```

> Two pitfalls found in testing, both recorded in code comments: (1) `raw.githubusercontent.com`
> returns 502 on some networks, so the sync uses `api.github.com`; (2) Node may report
> `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE` for GitHub (the system store has a chain Node's bundled CAs do
> not trust) — the sync **merges the system CA store automatically**, no CLI flag needed.

A filename containing the **song id** is most reliable (`11576.png`); `by-title/<title>.png` also
works (that is what the sync writes). Matching is **case-insensitive** — the database contains both
`Trust` and `TRUST`, which are the same file on Windows but two files on Linux.

One boolean per feature, `false` means off, with `'*'` as a fallback. All on by default.

Precedence:

```
QQ / runtime override file  >  composition config  >  code default (all on)
```

In other words, what was changed in QQ beats what is written in the config. Overrides live in
`qq-bridge/state/plugin-features.json`, written atomically (temp file plus rename) so another
process can never read half a JSON. They survive a DSH restart, and `#功能 reset` clears them.
A corrupt state file is treated as "no overrides" and the reason is recorded; it never stops the
plugin from starting.

Eight keys, all on by default:

| Key | Capability |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | Overview |
| `balance` | Balance and auto-shutdown |
| `schedule` | Billing peak/off-peak and reasoning tier |
| `holidays` | Holiday table |
| `greeting` | Startup / shutdown greetings |
| `commands` | Admin command status |
| `config` | Bridge config summary |
| `maimai` | MaimaiDX score lookup |

readme.section: What happens when a feature is off
readme.text:
- The action stays in the enum and answers with a clear sentence rather than being removed:

```
  ⛔ 功能「余额与自动关机」已在插件配置里关闭。
  当前开启的功能：status（总览）、schedule（计费峰谷与推理档位）…
  ```

It is not removed from the enum because the tool schema is serialized at `defineTool()` time and
  cannot be added to or removed from afterwards. Rather than fake "the config changed but the enum
  didn't", the off state is left visible.

readme.section: What happens when a feature is off
readme.text:
- The matching section in `status` states the reason: `⛔ 已关闭（features.balance=false）`.
- The system prompt is generated from the toggles, so disabled features are not advertised and
  the model does not waste an attempt on them.
- A misspelled toggle name is reported and recorded in `plugin-apply.json`'s trace. The usual
  trap with this kind of switch is writing `scheduler` instead of `schedule`, which looks like
  "set but not working".

---
All learned the hard way. Worth reading before changing the code.

readme.section: 1. `inject` must list every service you will touch
readme.text:
Cordis throws when you access a service property that was not declared in `inject`:

```
Error: cannot get property "systemPrompt" without inject
```

Only `tools` was declared at first, with `if (ctx.systemPrompt)` intended as an
optional-dependency fallback — but reading the property itself throws, so the fallback never
runs. In the plugin manager this shows up only as `[failed]` or "did not activate", with no
reason given.

readme.section: 2. Do not export `Config` unless it is a real schemastery schema
readme.text:
When the loader sees a `Config` export it validates against it and expects it to come from
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. A plain object fails before `apply` ever runs (the entry is created,
`apply` does not execute a single line). And schemastery is a bare specifier: if the plugin
directory has no `node_modules` of its own it cannot be resolved, and the whole module fails at
import time.

readme.section: 2. Do not export `Config` unless it is a real schemastery schema
readme.text:
There is a second measured boundary: `volatile` fields make the loader evaluate the config into
`{}`. A writable DSH settings panel requires `volatile`, but measurement (raw evidence kept in
`lib/last-apply-config.json`) showed that after evaluation every volatile field becomes `{}`, so
`sectionOrder` is no longer a number and `order must be a finite number` makes the plugin vanish
entirely. Even bypassing that, pressing Save in the settings panel would corrupt the config. So
this plugin's settings panel is read-only, and changing switches is done through QQ commands or
the config file. A test asserts this stays true.

readme.section: 3. `defineTool` must be a top-level static import
readme.text:
`lib/index.js` uses a static import with a hard-coded absolute path, the same approach official
plugins take. The first attempt used a runtime dynamic `import()` with 7 fallback paths for
"safety", and produced the hardest failure of all: one path reported import success, yet the
`.then()` on the chain never ran — no throw, no catch — so the tool was simply never registered.

readme.section: 3. `defineTool` must be a top-level static import
readme.text:
A plain node subprocess cannot read inside `app.asar`, so this module cannot be imported by plain
node. That is an Electron asar property, not a defect; use the tests under `test/`, which do not
import that file.

**Self-check for troubleshooting**: assembly writes `qq-bridge/state/plugin-apply.json`, whose
`trace` array records how far it got. The host console is invisible in the GUI and loader startup
failures give no reason, so this file is the only judge that requires no guessing.

---

The plugin and qq-bridge are a cross-repo dependency. qq-bridge reports both versions at startup:

```
[bridge] 版本：qq-bridge 0.2.0
[bridge]       插件：dsh-plugin-qqbridge-plus 1.1.1
```

Each side takes its version solely from its own `package.json` `version`, with no second copy.
Also learned the hard way: a version constant was once hard-coded in a module and contradicted
`package.json`, which amounts to having no trustworthy version at all.

---

```bash
npm test                                             # plugin side: 52 + 21
node ../qq-bridge/scripts/test-feature-command.mjs   # bridge pure functions: 28
node ../qq-bridge/scripts/e2e-feature-command.mjs    # end-to-end: 10 (both sides running)
```

CI runs only the two suites that do not need qq-bridge (52 + 21). The two that need a running
bridge stay local — a CI that always fails is worse than no CI.

Key safety and correctness assertions:

| Assertion | Why it matters |
| --- | --- |
| `config` summary must not contain an unredacted `accessToken` | model context is retained long-term |
| A misspelled toggle must not disable any feature | "set but not working" is the hardest to diagnose |
| No field may carry `volatile` | it makes the loader evaluate config into `{}`, corrupting it on save |
| The endpoint must reject or not register without a token | it can widen the entire tool surface |
| `#功能xyz` must not be treated as a command | a false positive swallows ordinary chat |
